answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable bond that unlocks only after its attestations match independent graders for 30 epochs. Collusion then works like a dye-pack pigment: when a cluster of accounts keeps attesting each other, the shared delta in their voting patterns marks every member, and all bonds in that cluster are slashed together. One sybil risks one bond; a hundred colluding sybils lose a hundred at once, so the network stops being a cheap haven for fake identities.
